metadata.name: GetNon-monetaryActivityLog
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is to get non monetary activity log.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of records which can be view in one Batch. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:20 Condition: If no value is pass in this tag then it will take by default value as 50.

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:10 Condition: If no value is pass in this tag then it will take by default as 0.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:7485122 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed

request_fields.name: FromDate
request_fields.description: From Date. Valid Values:01/12/1990 Format: MM/dd/yyyy Example:07/25/1991

request_fields.name: ToDate
request_fields.description: To Date. Valid Values:01/12/1990 Format: MM/dd/yyyy Example:07/25/1991

request_fields.name: IsAdmiNumberMandatory
request_fields.description: To check admin num mandatory Valid Values:0-1 Format:XXXXX Example:7485122 Condition:At least one Account identifier input parameter should be passed

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ActivityDateTime
children.description: Date and time of activity Valid Values:0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:01/01/2020 12:10:01

children.name: UserID
children.description: User Id of user who performed the activity. Valid Values: A-Z, O-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example:User123 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: Source
children.description: Source through which Activity is performed. Valid Values: Web,Corecredit, CoreCollect, CreditSelfService and System. Example: CoreCredit Allowable Values: 50

children.name: Details
children.description: Details of activity. Valid Values:A-Z, O-9 Example: Request For Secondary Card Allowable Values: 256

children.name: RequestOutCome
children.description: Outcome of Request. Example: Successful Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: ResponseMessage
children.description: Action message for activity Valid Values:A-Z, O-9 Example:Secondary Card created successfully Allowable Values: 256
